identification: Eight British half crowns in handwritten flips: 1881 QV young head, 1900 x2 QV veiled head, 1902 and 1907 Edward VII, 1921 x2 George V, one George VI. By photo the Victorian and Edwardian coins look about F, the George VI about EF. Five are .925 sterling (about 14.1g each, about 70g gross, about 65g fine silver) and three are .500 (about 14.1g each, about 42g gross, about 21g fine).
